name: job-search-skill
description: Marketplace for the job-search skill: resume-aware job discovery, deterministic ranking, tailored applications, and guarded auto-apply.

plugins.name: job-search
plugins.description: Search job boards for roles matching your resume, stack-rank them with a deterministic fit score, remember what was seen/dismissed/applied, tailor a resume + cover letter per job, and fill applications via Playwright MCP behind a submit guard.
